_comment: Pins the overworld clock to MIDNIGHT (18000) for the sleep gametest. 26.2's Player.tick force-wakes any sleeper whose position fails the BED_RULE environment attribute, and the overworld's rule is WHEN_DARK = Level.isDarkOutside() (javap) — so a sleep held across driven living ticks is impossible in daylight. The gametest server SAVES AND REUSES build/run/gametest/world/, so the world clock is inherited from previous runs: without this pin the test's outcome is a function of how many runs that world dir has accumulated (green on a warm night-time world, red on a cold one). Same vanilla clock_time definition as carpentersblocks' night.json; setup saves the previous total ticks and teardown restores them.
